models.description: Muse Spark 1.3 through OpenCode Zen's paid Responses route. Unlike the -contributor variants this needs no data-collection opt in, and unlike -contributor-free it works outside the OpenCode client. Verified 2026-09-08: POST https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/responses returns 200 for this model; the same model returns 401 on the /zen/go/v1 route, which is why this entry uses its own provider variant. The same endpoint refuses a function tool carrying `strict: true` whose `required` omits any property (HTTP 400 `'required' is required to be supplied and to be an array including every key in properties`) and accepts the identical schema with the flag removed, so this route drops it rather than making Codex's optional tool arguments mandatory. Verified 2026-09-08 on the same paid Responses endpoint: web_search with search_content_types returns HTTP 400, while the identical tool without that field returns 200, so the router removes only that field for this model.
